### Praying the Names of God - October 7
Author: Ann Spangler
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/prayingnamesgod/praying-the-names-of-god-october-19.html
Passage: Psalm 97:1-4
Points:
- The awe-inspiring power of thunderstorms points to God's supreme majesty over all creation.
- The Lord reigns as the ultimate King over every nation, person, and natural element.
- Righteousness and justice form the unshakable foundation of His heavenly throne.
- Witnessing God's holiness prompts believers to examine their hearts and confess hidden sins.
- We are called to praise His greatness and ask Him to extend His kingdom through us.
